title: LABEL_PACKET
description: One record emitted by the label pipeline (Phase 0C authority model). claim_bearing is DERIVED, never free: it is true ONLY when authority is a gold authority (CONSTRUCTION_GOLD, RESOURCE_GOLD, OWNER_CORRECTED) AND audit_state == OWNER_APPROVED AND the required approval digests are present AND phase_approval_valid is true. Candidate authorities (RESOURCE_RULE_DERIVED, CONSTRUCTION_CANDIDATE), fixtures (CONTROLLED_TEMPLATE_FIXTURE), MODEL_PROPOSED, WEAK_LABEL, and ABSTAIN are NEVER claim-bearing. Gold packets exist only as output of owner_gated_promotion.py; schema-level if/then blocks below encode the coupling so external validators enforce it too.

authority.description: Who/what established the label. Gold (first three) only via owner-gated promotion.

cas_label.description: The CAS class, or null for ABSTAIN / evidence-only packets.

claim_bearing.description: Derived, never free. See the top-level description for the four required conditions.

audit_state.description: Audit progress. Only OWNER_APPROVED can support claim_bearing.

approval_manifest_digest.description: sha256 of the approved source manifest; set by promotion.

owner_approval_digest.description: sha256 of the owner-signed approval record; set by promotion.

phase_approval_valid.description: True only after the promotion program verified the owner-signed phase approval.

sense.description: Present for RESOURCE_RULE_DERIVED / RESOURCE_GOLD / WEAK_LABEL / ABSTAIN over a frozen sense.

construction.description: Present for CONSTRUCTION_CANDIDATE / CONSTRUCTION_GOLD / CONTROLLED_TEMPLATE_FIXTURE: the label existed BEFORE surface realization.

fired_rules.description: Rule ids that fired on the frozen text.

blocked_rules.description: Rule ids whose include matched but an exclude term blocked them.

evidence.description: Model-assembled, NON-authoritative. Advisory only. Never sets the label. Phase 0C schema: source_frame_id and proposed_cas_class are SEPARATE fields (the old frame_or_class overload is retired); sense_id and the model identity receipt are required inside the block.

source_locator.description: "<resource_id>#<sense_id>"; must resolve to the cited sense.

exact_gloss.description: Byte-identical quote of the frozen gloss.

source_frame_id.description: The resource's frame id; null only if the record has none.

proposed_rule_id.description: A rule id existing in the rule table, or "NONE". Advisory only.

preservation_check.description: "shared_verb_lookup" marks the retired circular fixture generator; promotion refuses it.
